what: Letter-shaped panels (V groove · two bumps · S blob · hook, 267×150) are lined up at 60px spacing, with odd rows offset by half a cell to cover the entire board — the green deepens down the rows, and every panel has a doorknob ring. Every 1.5s two panels on screen (not overlapping the previous pair) have their doors swing open −20° on the left hinge, revealing the bright face down to 70% at the bottom right (.5s power2.inOut), rest for 1s, then close along the same curve. The center lime panel (main) receives fx:open and stands with its door left open at −50°

options.gap: Gap between panels (px), default 60 — original wide screen
options.every: Open two at a time every few seconds, default 1.5
options.shapes: Plate shapes v·b·s·h written with spaces, default all
options.main: Lime door panel position ”row,column” (from 0), default none
options.start: If event, starts when fx:play is sent to the element (after the intro ends), default right on attach
options.--fx-tile: Panel base green (CSS variable), default var(--kf-accent-text)
options.--fx-step: Amount of ink mixed in per line down (css variable), default 9%
options.--fx-main: Center board color (css variable), default var(--kf-accent)
options.fx:open: Sent to the element, the center panel door opens to −50° in 1s power3.inOut

note: The panel shapes are the four shapes of this part, not the original logo letters. The panel size is fixed at 267×150, so to use it small, give the wrapping element zoom or scale

from.where: index.html hero .kv__wall — original DRzmvrgl.js: every 1.5s it picks two .letter-item, .base-reflect rotateY −20 .5s power2.inOut + clipPath polygon(…70% 100%) → rest 1s → return, the center is-main door .door rotateY −50 1s power3.inOut
